demos.title: Polyglot Maze Solver Suite
demos.description: AMI creates a random maze generator in Python, a Rust maze solver using BFS, and a shell script that orchestrates both—generating a maze, solving it, and printing the solution path overlaid on the maze with ANSI color highlights.

demos.title: Script README generator
demos.description: AMI writes a small Python script, then generates a concise README documenting it, and prints the final README to the terminal.

demos.title: Fractal Mandelbrot Set in ASCII
demos.description: AMI plans, writes, and runs a pure-Python Mandelbrot set renderer that outputs a detailed ASCII-art fractal to the terminal, demonstrating planning, file creation, execution, and visual output — all with zero dependencies.

demos.title: Multi-module CLI app
demos.description: AMI builds a modular unit-converter CLI split across several Python files, wires them together, and runs a conversion to print a readable result.

demos.title: JSON to Human Report
demos.description: AMI takes raw inline JSON data and writes a Python script that parses it into a clean, formatted plain-text report, then runs the script to display the result.

demos.title: Git Init, Commit & Diff
demos.description: Initializes a git repo, creates files across two commits, then displays the log and a diff between them to verify history.

demos.title: Monte Carlo Pi Estimation
demos.description: Creates and runs a Python script that estimates pi by randomly sampling points in a unit square, counting how many fall inside the unit circle, then prints a clear summary comparing the estimate to the true value.

demos.title: Edge-case tests expose and fix bug
demos.description: AMI writes a buggy function, adds edge-case tests that reveal the bug, then fixes the function so all tests pass—demonstrating test-driven bug fixing.

demos.title: Refactor repetitive function into helpers
demos.description: AMI takes a single Python file with a long, repetitive function full of duplicated logic, refactors it into clean small helper functions, runs tests to prove behavior is identical, and prints a before/after summary.

demos.title: Refactor Nested Conditionals Data-Driven
demos.description: AMI creates a Python script with deeply nested if/elif/else blocks, refactors it into a clean dictionary-lookup approach, then runs both versions and diffs their output to prove behavior is unchanged.

demos.title: Fix type bug, verify fix
demos.description: AMI finds and fixes a subtle type-coercion bug in a Python function that silently returns wrong results, then verifies the fix by running test cases.

demos.title: Fix path traversal vulnerability
demos.description: AMI reviews a Python file-server script that has a path traversal vulnerability, patches it to safely reject directory escape attempts, then runs before-and-after tests proving the fix blocks malicious input.

demos.title: Dynamic Programming Coin Change
demos.description: AMI implements the classic coin-change dynamic-programming algorithm in Python, solves a worked example, and prints a step-by-step breakdown showing the minimum coins needed and which coins were chosen.

demos.title: Serial vs Parallel Speedup
demos.description: Creates a CPU-bound task (computing large checksums), runs it serially then in parallel with threads, and prints a side-by-side comparison proving both produce identical results while the parallel version is faster.

demos.title: Fix Off-by-One Bug
demos.description: AMI creates a Python function with a subtle off-by-one error, discovers the bug by running tests, fixes it, and re-runs to prove correctness.

demos.title: Graph Shortest Path Solver
demos.description: AMI writes a Dijkstra shortest-path solver from scratch, builds a small weighted graph, and prints the shortest path with its total cost.

demos.title: Design a CLI README
demos.description: This demo invokes the cognitive-doc-design skill to create a clear, well-structured README for a small command-line tool. It then prints the completed README directly to the terminal as a concise final result.

demos.title: Polish an HTML Button
demos.description: This demo invokes the impeccable skill, applies its accessibility and visual-design guidance to a plain HTML button, and writes a polished index.html in the current directory. It finishes by printing a concise one-line summary.

demos.title: Kali MCP Port Scan
demos.description: Demonstrates using the Kali MCP server to scan TCP port 57889 on 172.17.0.1. It reports a concise, readable open-or-closed result directly in the terminal.

demos.title: Constellation Detective
demos.description: AMI builds a deterministic procedural mystery in Python, combining graph algorithms, parsing, testing, and polished terminal output. It generates a constellation, finds the hidden culprit through clues, and prints a concise case report.

demos.title: The Tiny City Heist
demos.description: AMI invents a miniature city DSL, validates it, solves a constrained shortest-path mystery, and renders the final reveal as a polished terminal case file. The demo shows code generation, testing, parsing, graph algorithms, and presentation in one self-contained run.

demos.title: Signal Garden Observatory
demos.description: AMI builds a dependency-free Python observatory that generates synthetic sensor data, detects anomalies with robust statistics, and renders both a compact terminal dashboard and an SVG artifact. It includes automated tests and ends by printing a clear anomaly report with summary metrics.

demos.title: README Demo
demos.description: Creates a tiny self-contained example script and a concise README for it. Prints the finished README directly to the terminal for a clear final result.

demos.title: Document a Tiny CLI Module
demos.description: AMI creates a small self-contained Python module with clear docstrings and a command-line interface, then runs it to display readable usage and help output.

demos.title: Two-Stage Git Demo
demos.description: This demo initializes a repository, creates two small files, commits them in separate stages, and displays the commit history plus the changes between commits. It finishes with a concise, readable summary in the terminal.

demos.title: Modular CLI Converter
demos.description: Builds a small multi-file units converter with separate conversion and CLI modules. The agent wires the modules together, runs the program, and prints a concise conversion summary.

demos.title: CSV Sales Summary
demos.description: Shows AMI building a small CSV-reporting utility and running it on local sample data. The utility groups sales by product and prints a concise, readable summary with totals.

demos.title: JSON to Human Report
demos.description: AMI turns an inline sales JSON document into a concise, readable terminal report. It creates and runs a local script with no network access or animated output.

demos.title: Inline Dataset Statistics
demos.description: The agent creates and runs a self-contained script that computes the mean, median, and top three values from an inline dataset. It prints a concise, readable summary directly in the terminal.

demos.title: Inline CSV Summary Table
demos.description: This demo shows AMI creating a self-contained script that parses inline CSV data and prints a clean, aligned summary table. It runs entirely in the current directory with no network access.

demos.title: Monte Carlo Pi Estimate
demos.description: Creates and runs a self-contained Python simulation that estimates π using random points in a unit square. It prints a concise summary with the sample count, estimated value, and error.

demos.title: Solve the 100 Doors Puzzle
demos.description: AMI writes and runs a self-contained Python program that solves the classic 100 doors puzzle. It prints the open doors and a concise explanation of the square-number pattern.

demos.title: Tiny Arithmetic Parser
demos.description: Builds a self-contained tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic expressions, then evaluates several examples and prints their results.

demos.title: Coin Change DP Demo
demos.description: Shows AMI implementing a dynamic-programming coin-change solver from scratch. It runs a worked example and prints the minimum coins, selected coins, and a compact verification result.

demos.title: BFS Shortest Path
demos.description: AMI builds and runs a self-contained Python BFS demo in the current directory. It finds and prints the shortest path between two vertices in an example graph.

demos.title: Merge Sort From Scratch
demos.description: AMI implements merge sort without external libraries, then runs it on sample data. The terminal shows the original and sorted lists as a concise final result.

demos.title: Parameterized Utility Tests
demos.description: The demo has AMI create a small utility function and a self-contained parameterized test suite in the current directory. It runs the tests and prints a concise passing summary to the terminal.

demos.title: Edge Cases Expose a Bug
demos.description: AMI creates a small slugification utility with an existing edge-case bug, adds focused tests that expose it, then fixes the implementation. It runs the tests and prints a concise passing summary.

demos.title: Tiny Module, Passing Tests
demos.description: AMI creates a small Python module and focused pytest suite in the current directory, then runs the tests. The demo ends with a concise passing-test summary printed in the terminal.

demos.title: Threads Beat Serial
demos.description: This demo compares serial and threaded execution of independent tasks. It verifies both produce the same result and prints a concise timing comparison showing the speedup.

demos.title: Benchmark Then Optimize
demos.description: This demo creates a deliberately slow duplicate-detection function, measures it, replaces it with a faster set-based algorithm, and compares both timings. It ends by printing a concise before/after speedup summary.

demos.title: Extract and Verify Logic
demos.description: AMI refactors duplicated Python logic into a reusable function in the current directory. It runs a before-and-after comparison and prints a concise matching result.

demos.title: Data-Driven Conditional Refactor
demos.description: The agent creates a self-contained example with nested conditionals, refactors it to a clear data-driven design, and verifies both versions produce identical output. It finishes by printing a concise PASS result in the terminal.

demos.title: Refactor Repetitive Formatter
demos.description: AMI creates a deliberately repetitive formatter, refactors it into small helpers without changing behavior, and verifies the result. The demo ends with concise test output and a readable before/after summary.

demos.title: Fix the Shell Injection
demos.description: AMI creates a tiny vulnerable report function, demonstrates command injection, then fixes it with safe argument handling and validation. A concise test run proves the exploit is blocked and prints a readable PASS result.

demos.title: Fix Path Traversal
demos.description: AMI reviews a deliberately vulnerable Python file-reader, identifies and fixes its path traversal flaw, then verifies that a valid read succeeds while a traversal attempt is safely rejected.

demos.title: Fix the Type Bug
demos.description: The agent investigates a small function that returns incorrect results because it compares values of incompatible types. It fixes the implementation and verifies the behavior with several examples, ending with a concise pass/fail summary.

demos.title: Traceback to Working Script
demos.description: AMI creates a self-contained script that crashes on a specific input, diagnoses the traceback, fixes the root cause, and reruns it successfully. The demo ends with a concise result printed directly in the terminal.

demos.title: Fix the Hidden Off-by-One
demos.description: The demo creates a small Python function with a subtle off-by-one bug, runs a failing check, fixes the implementation, and reruns it successfully. It ends with a concise PASS summary printed to the terminal.
